query: Anthropic MCP Hub/marketplace evidence on GitHub
ground_truth_summary: As of 2026-05-22, no official Anthropic MCP Hub, marketplace, billing, or payment repository exists on either github.com/anthropics or github.com/modelcontextprotocol. No issues, PRs, or discussions in those organizations reference 'marketplace', 'hub', 'billing', 'monetization', or 'payment'. The modelcontextprotocol organization contains only specification, server/client examples, SDKs, and documentation repos. No monetization infrastructure is implemented or publicly planned.
implication_for_agents: Agents cannot rely on an official MCP marketplace for revenue. Alternative revenue models: (1) operate as MCP server providers charging per-request via external payment APIs (e.g., Stripe, OpenNode), (2) offer premium MCP server access via subscription tokens on-chain, (3) build custom agent-to-agent billing using smart contracts (e.g., on Base or Solana). No first-party billing exists.
